articles.title: China’s intelligence chief warns of risks from AI as ‘new arena for strategic rivalry’
articles.summary: China's intelligence chief has highlighted the escalating national security threats posed by artificial intelligence, urging for comprehensive risk management and global governance, as the country positions itself as a leader in AI regulation amidst rising tensions with the U.S. This warning underscores the critical need for international collaboration to navigate the complexities of AI in an era of strategic rivalry.

articles.title: Perplexity trusts GPT-6 Astra with end-to-end systems
articles.summary: Perplexity's integration of GPT-6 Astra marks a transformative leap in AI capabilities, enabling seamless end-to-end system management that significantly reduces the need for human oversight in tasks like communication, software updates, and production monitoring. This breakthrough not only enhances operational efficiency but also sets a new standard for AI's role in automating complex processes across industries.

articles.title: Chinese researchers extend future memory endurance 100-fold in semiconductor advance
articles.summary: Chinese researchers have achieved a groundbreaking advancement in semiconductor technology by extending the memory endurance of wurtzite ferroelectrics by 100-fold, enabling over 10 billion writing cycles and significantly enhancing the durability of memory chips for high-performance computing and future AI applications. This breakthrough addresses a critical reliability barrier, positioning these advanced semiconductors as essential for meeting the surging demand driven by the AI boom.
